Name: Mouth
Description: Create JaW and Lips System for Games

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Jaw and lips system for games, from humans to long snouts.
  Jaw: Mouth_Jaw_Ctrl with lip collision and a dynamic pivot (the JawPivot guide sets where the jaw rotates, Mouth_JawPivot_Ctrl moves it in the scene, show it with Mouth_Jaw_Ctrl.PivotCtrl). Jaw followers (teeth, tongue) go under Mouth_JawFollow_Null so they keep their place when the pivot moves.
  Lips: joints spaced evenly by length along each lip edge. Mid ctrls translate, scale and rotate: rotating one bends the lip around it, rx rolls the lip there. Tweak ctrls push the joints around them with a soft falloff. Every lip ctrl scales per axis and the scale falls off over the lip like its translate.
  Main ctrls: Roll on Mouth_Up/Dw_Main_Ctrl. On L/R_Mouth_Main_Ctrl: Zip, MidFollow / MidFalloff (how much the corner drags each mid ctrl, high falloff = the front barely moves), CornerAim / AimFalloff (mid ctrls turn toward the corner as it moves) and AimMult (exaggerates that turn).
  Buccal flap (optional): L/R_Mouth_Flap_Ctrl between one upper and one lower lip joint, squashes as the lips close (FlapBlend / Squash / Stretch on the flap ctrl).

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetParent: node the whole mouth follows (e.g. Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl). new_locator makes a placeholder.
- SetAttrsPosition: node that gets the Mouth_Vis attrs (e.g. Vis_Ctrl). new_locator makes a placeholder.
- SetUpperEdge: upper lip edge loop, corner to corner.
- SetLowerEdge: lower lip edge loop, corner to corner.
- TweakCtrlsAmount: tweak ctrls per lip, corners not counted (default 7).
- MidCtrlsAmount: mid ctrls per lip (default 5).
- CtrlSize: ctrl size (default 4).
- BindJoints: PerVtx = one joint per vertex of the lip edge, or a fixed joint count per lip.
- MidCtrlTangents: on = mid ctrls spaced evenly on the lip, rotating them bends the lip. Off = mid ctrls translate only (older driver curve).
- BuccalFlap: adds L/R_Mouth_Flap_Ctrl + Bnd joint at the mouth corner.
- SetFlapUpperJoint: upper lip joint the flap hangs from (select it and press Set). Left side, the right side is mirrored. Empty = the joint next to the corner.
- SetFlapLowerJoint: lower lip joint the flap hangs from, same rules as SetFlapUpperJoint.

Mouth Style Advice:
- Human / short mouth: defaults. MidFollow 1, MidFalloff 1, CornerAim 0.
- Reptile / long snout: MidFalloff 2-4 so the corner does not drag the front of the snout, CornerAim 0.5-1 with AimMult 3-8 to curve the lip into the corner, BuccalFlap on.
- More bend between mid ctrls: use more BindJoints than mid ctrls (15, 21 or PerVtx). With the same count every joint sits on a ctrl and rotation only turns that joint.
- Teeth / tongue blocks: SetParent Mouth_JawFollow_Null, never Mouth_Jaw_Ctrl (constraints on the jaw ctrl jump when the pivot moves).

Tips:
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
